title: CerebralHelm Note Metadata
description: The system-managed YAML frontmatter of a durable Markdown note (FR-KNW-05). Markdown is the source of truth; this is the metadata block the system reads and writes. User-added frontmatter keys are preserved by the note codec and are outside this contract. Safe defaults are applied when optional fields are absent, and cloudPolicy defaults to deny or ask — never allow.

kind.description: Note kind (e.g. note, daily, project-note, reference).

project.description: Optional durable project or area this note belongs to. Modes reference these; they do not duplicate the note.

cloudPolicy.description: Whether the note may be sent to a cloud provider. Defaults to deny; never defaults to allow.

reviewAfter.description: Optional freshness boundary: after this instant the note is due for review.
